authorized_by: PI, 2026-09-22, following the sealed DEFEND_ATTACK_SPLIT_POLICY_A_V1_SPEC 200k run + n=64 exploratory eval (commit 9dccb4d6): 'Do not touch the trained policies. Seal them. Correct the delta-sign wording. Run a fresh confirmatory crossover evaluation... Do not train further right now.'

CANONICAL_DELTA_CONVENTION_locked.correction: DEFEND_ATTACK_SPLIT_POLICY_A_V1_SPEC.json and its predecessor DEFEND_TEACHER_ROLE_CONDITIONING_A_V1_SPEC.json both quoted an estimand for delta_B (V(pi_new,B)-V(pi_B,B)) that reads the SAME underlying quantity with the OPPOSITE sign from this program's own long-established crossover definition -- the one experiments/eval_specialist_crossover_scaled.py has implemented, unchanged, since the 2v2 specialist baseline. That inherited wording is retired for this and all future records in this line. It was never a different measurement, only a sign flip of the same number; no prior sealed numeric result is invalidated by this correction.

canonical_definition.crossover_confirmed_iff: mean(delta_A) > 0 AND LCB95(delta_A) > 0 AND mean(delta_B) > 0 AND LCB95(delta_B) > 0
canonical_definition.reading: delta_A > 0 means pi_A beats pi_B on Pole A (pi_A's own specialty). delta_B > 0 means pi_B beats pi_A on Pole B (pi_B's own specialty). BOTH positive is the crossover signature: each specialist dominates its own pole and is weaker on the other's -- this is the DESIRED pattern, not a defect. A specialist that is ALSO strong on the opposing pole is a generalist, not evidence of successful specialization, and was the original failure mode this whole research line exists to move away from.

CANONICAL_DELTA_CONVENTION_locked.applies_to: this record and all future DEFEND_ATTACK_SPLIT_POLICY_A_V1-lineage records. Does not retroactively edit the frozen text of DEFEND_TEACHER_ROLE_CONDITIONING_A_V1_SPEC.json or DEFEND_ATTACK_SPLIT_POLICY_A_V1_SPEC.json themselves -- those files stay as originally frozen, per this program's own discipline against rewriting frozen specs; this record is the correction of record going forward.
